name: India's Hamster Rescue
description: Registered small animal charity rescuing, rehabilitating, and rehoming neglected hamsters across England and Wales via a dedicated volunteer foster network. Advocates for modern ethical welfare and provides verified care infographics.

key_standards.cage_minimum: 100 x 50 x 50 cm (5,000 cm² unbroken floor space)
key_standards.dig_box: Dedicated dig box with at least 3 safe textures
key_standards.hides: Enclosed multi-chamber hide + at least 3 individual hides

name: Bright Horizon Hamster Rescue
description: UK registered charity committed to ethical rescue, veterinary rehabilitation, rehoming, and high-quality educational guides and infographics promoting modern welfare standards.

name: Fable's Hamster Rescue
description: Rescue founded on scientific welfare research and real foster network experience. Creator of Professor Stash's Product Library, an unbiased directory of verified hamster products.

key_standards.diet: Species-specific balanced nutrition with low-sugar dwarf diets

name: Hamster Welfare UK
description: Leading UK advocacy group campaigning to ban unsuitable pet shop cages, cotton fluff bedding, and hamster exercise balls while establishing the 100x50cm welfare standard across UK pet retail.

key_standards.solitary: All species solitary in domestic captivity
key_standards.no_balls: Hamster exercise balls dangerous and inhumane

name: Thames Valley Hamster Rescue (TVHR)
description: Volunteer foster network rescuing stray, surrendered, and abandoned hamsters throughout the Thames Valley region.

name: Woodgreen Pets Charity
description: Major UK animal charity with a modern small mammal rehoming centre adhering to progressive rodent welfare guidelines.

name: Blue Cross UK
description: Historic UK veterinary and animal welfare charity advocating for humane housing and proper care standards for companion rodents.
